title: KP release-baseline recovery

sourceRefs.summary: Run-contract target that explains why this generated contract exists.
User-approved 20-slice proposal amended to repair Animation Host rendering first.
Strategic sequence placing bounded baseline recovery before economics without changing promotion rank.

allowedWork: Repair only the approved Animation Host failure and six named architecture or payload failures.
Extend existing attribution, context-encoding, dependency-boundary, payload, and project-memory checks when directly required.
Commit each completed slice with exact Theseus evidence while preserving unrelated dirty files.
disallowedWork: Do not raise numeric ceilings, weaken audits, or move code outside measured closures.
Do not add a renderer, runtime, clock, scene graph, display page, universal sanitizer, or duplicated rational authority.
Do not change place-value choreography or begin economics, physics, API tiers, generator, LLM, motif, or harvest work.
goal: Repair Animation Host rendering first, then restore the six named architecture and payload gates without raising ceilings or beginning economics.
commitCadence: Commit after each completed and proportionately verified slice; stop for human review on any visible behavior change.
stopConditions: Stop if Animation Host rendering cannot be reproduced deterministically or its repair changes visible loading, layout, interaction, or animation behavior.
Stop if a numeric ceiling must be raised, an audit weakened, or code moved outside a measured closure.
Stop if public API, routes, canonical typography, motion, ownership, accessibility, Review, or export behavior must change.
Stop if a new renderer, runtime, clock, scene graph, duplicated rational authority, or unrelated project is required.
Stop if approved work overlaps inseparably with unrelated user changes or a subjective browser judgment is required.
Stop before economics implementation and finish as STOP_CONDITION if any named release gate remains red.

slices.title: repair-animation-host-rendering
slices.summary: Repaired the shared host operational boundary: restarted the stale process, added persistent-server catalog and rapid-switch liveness coverage, excluded disposable tmp/codex artifacts from Vite watching, and added a regression proving scratch writes cannot reload or strand the webview. Persistent and clean hosts, display smoke, typecheck, build, and production-review closure pass.
